scope: First H3 topology LoRA launch in the generic GPU environment
summary: The launch stopped before model construction or optimization because transformers 4.51.3 does not export Qwen3VLConfig required by the pinned H3 source.
evidence: Preflight selected physical A800 GPU 1 with 81,225 MiB free and validated all dataset and checkpoint hashes.
The trainer raised ImportError while importing the H3 text encoder; zero checkpoints and zero optimizer steps were produced.
lessons: H3 training must use the already-proven .venv-h3 environment rather than the generic .venv-gpu runtime.
limitations: This attempt provides environment diagnostics only and no training evidence.
next_actions: Relaunch in a new immutable directory with .venv-h3 without altering the shared generic environment.
